prompt: How old was the future 34th president 5 years after the founding of the National Football League?
answer: The future 34th president was **Dwight D. Eisenhower**, born October 14, 1890. The NFL was founded on September 17, 1920, so five years later—September 17, 1925—he was **34 years old**.
